```bash
gh issue create -R YOUR_ORG/PainPal-MobileApp --title "fix: improve history empty state" --label "good first issue,mobile"

gh issue create -R YOUR_ORG/PainPal-MobileApp --title "a11y: Semantics on log attack form" --label "help wanted,accessibility,mobile"
```
